//: Type-check only. Editors pick this up automatically for files with a `// @ts-check` pragma. To check from the CLI: `npm run typecheck` (runs `tsc -p aipass-bridge/jsconfig.json`). No build step, no runtime dependency, no output. checkJs stays false so un-annotated files are not checked; files opt in with `// @ts-check`. The include is a glob, not a file list: a new module (e.g. harness/run/preflight.mjs) is covered the day it lands, instead of drifting out of the check until someone notices. desktop/ui is mostly not included: the state and rpc modules are (they are DOM-free — plain data and a fetch client — so the current lib covers them), while the rest of the window needs its own DOM config; see docs/TECH_STACK.md.
